seo.title: Big Sky ski resort guide
seo.description: 5,850 acres under the 11,166-foot summit of Lone Peak in Montana's Madison Range, with 300 degrees of skiing from the top.

seo.webpageDescription: Ski facts, where to stay and how to get to Big Sky in Montana.

h1: Big Sky ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Lone Peak rises to 11,166 feet above Big Sky, and from the summit the resort offers 300 degrees of skiing across 5,850 acres. The village sits at 2,200 metres in Montana's Madison Range, an hour from Bozeman and an hour from Yellowstone.
stayOverview: Mountain Village sits under Lone Peak with the tram above it; Meadow Village is further down the canyon and cheaper; the Gallatin Canyon road runs between them towards Bozeman.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. Mountain Village is the ski-in option; the others need the shuttle or a car.
rentalCars: Big Sky is about an hour from Bozeman airport on Highway 191, through the Gallatin Canyon.
